domain_reviews.coverage_statement: Reviewed the county planning jurisdiction page and discoverable Wooster zoning records through September 9, 2026; the county notes that most unincorporated territory has no county zoning.
domain_reviews.finding: Wooster's code defines data centers and recent zoning tables address the use, but no candidate-specific facility, application, or developer approach was identified.
limitations: Wayne County has multiple municipal and township jurisdictions without a unified, full-text historical application index.
A zoning definition or permitted-use table is not evidence that a project was proposed.

domain_reviews.coverage_statement: Reviewed indexed local-news results, the public library's historical newspaper portal, and WEDC's current resource library through September 9, 2026.
domain_reviews.finding: No qualifying local project announcement, controversy, milestone, or public-hearing record was identified in the accessible results.
limitations: The Daily Record blocks automated page access and its complete 1999-present archive requires a local library-card session.
The public preservation portal has uneven title coverage after 1963 and therefore cannot certify modern absence.
